# google_cloud_identity_inbound_saml_sso_profile_idp_credential

An IdP credential used to verify signatures produced by the SAML identity
provider of an inbound SAML SSO profile. The credential is an X.509
certificate. A SAML SSO profile must have at least one IdP credential before
it can be assigned to users or groups. Up to 2 credentials are allowed per
profile. The last credential of a profile can't be deleted while the profile
is assigned; delete the assignment first.

The caller must be a Google Workspace / Cloud Identity administrator of the
customer with the SSO settings privilege (for example a super admin);
Google Cloud IAM roles are not sufficient.

If you are using User ADCs (Application Default Credentials) with this resource,
you must specify a `billing_project` and set `user_project_override` to true
in the provider configuration. Otherwise the Cloud Identity API will return a 403 error.
Your account must have the `serviceusage.services.use` permission on the
`billing_project` you defined.


To get more information about InboundSamlSsoProfileIdpCredential, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/identity/docs/reference/rest/v1/inboundSamlSsoProfiles.idpCredentials)
* How-to Guides
    * [Set up SSO with a third party IdP](https://support.google.com/a/answer/12032922)

~> **Warning:** If the customer has enabled
[Multi-party approval for sensitive actions](https://knowledge.workspace.google.com/admin/security/multi-party-approval-for-sensitive-actions),
the API defers adding a credential until a second administrator approves it
(the returned operation has `"done": false` and metadata `"state": "awaiting-multi-party-approval"`,
see the [API reference](https://cloud.google.com/identity/docs/reference/rest/v1/inboundSamlSsoProfiles.idpCredentials/add)).
Terraform returns an error in this case. Once approved, the newly added
credential can be imported.


## Example Usage - Cloud Identity Inbound Saml Sso Profile Idp Credential Basic


```hcl
resource "google_cloud_identity_inbound_saml_sso_profile" "saml_profile" {
  customer     = "customers/A01b123xz"
  display_name = "saml-profile"

  idp_config {
    entity_id                  = "https://idp.example.com/saml-profile"
    single_sign_on_service_uri = "https://idp.example.com/sso"
  }
}

resource "tls_private_key" "idp_signing_key" {
  algorithm = "RSA"
  rsa_bits  = 2048
}

resource "tls_self_signed_cert" "idp_signing_cert" {
  private_key_pem = tls_private_key.idp_signing_key.private_key_pem

  subject {
    common_name = "idp.example.com"
  }

  validity_period_hours = 8760

  allowed_uses = [
    "digital_signature",
  ]
}

resource "google_cloud_identity_inbound_saml_sso_profile_idp_credential" "idp_credential" {
  inbound_saml_sso_profile_id = google_cloud_identity_inbound_saml_sso_profile.saml_profile.inbound_saml_sso_profile_id
  pem_data                    = tls_self_signed_cert.idp_signing_cert.cert_pem
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `pem_data` -
  (Required)
  PEM encoded X.509 certificate containing the public key for verifying
  IdP signatures. This field is input-only and is not returned by the API.

* `inbound_saml_sso_profile_id` -
  (Required)
  The server-assigned ID of the SAML SSO profile that owns this credential
  (the last segment of the profile's resource name, not the full
  `inboundSamlSsoProfiles/{id}` name). It is available as
  `google_cloud_identity_inbound_saml_sso_profile.<name>.inbound_saml_sso_profile_id`.


* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `inboundSamlSsoProfiles/{{inbound_saml_sso_profile_id}}/idpCredentials/{{idp_credential_id}}`

* `name` -
  Resource name of the IdP credential, assigned by the server.
  Format: `inboundSamlSsoProfiles/{inbound_saml_sso_profile_id}/idpCredentials/{idp_credential_id}`.

* `idp_credential_id` -
  The server-assigned ID of the IdP credential (the last segment of `name`).

* `rsa_key_info` -
  Information of an RSA public key.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_rsa_key_info).

* `dsa_key_info` -
  Information of a DSA public key.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_dsa_key_info).

* `update_time` -
  Time when the IdP credential was last updated.


<a name="nested_rsa_key_info"></a>The `rsa_key_info` block contains:

* `key_size` -
  (Output)
  Key size in bits (size of the modulus).

<a name="nested_dsa_key_info"></a>The `dsa_key_info` block contains:

* `key_size` -
  (Output)
  Key size in bits (size of parameter P).

## Import


InboundSamlSsoProfileIdpCredential can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `inboundSamlSsoProfiles/{{inbound_saml_sso_profile_id}}/idpCredentials/{{idp_credential_id}}`
* `{{inbound_saml_sso_profile_id}}/{{idp_credential_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import InboundSamlSsoProfileIdpCredential using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    idpCredentialId = "<-optional value->"
    inboundSamlSsoProfileId = "<-required value->"
  }
  to = google_cloud_identity_inbound_saml_sso_profile_idp_credential.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import InboundSamlSsoProfileIdpCredential using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "inboundSamlSsoProfiles/{{inbound_saml_sso_profile_id}}/idpCredentials/{{idp_credential_id}}"
  to = google_cloud_identity_inbound_saml_sso_profile_idp_credential.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), InboundSamlSsoProfileIdpCredential can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_cloud_identity_inbound_saml_sso_profile_idp_credential.default inboundSamlSsoProfiles/{{inbound_saml_sso_profile_id}}/idpCredentials/{{idp_credential_id}}
$ terraform import google_cloud_identity_inbound_saml_sso_profile_idp_credential.default {{inbound_saml_sso_profile_id}}/{{idp_credential_id}}
```
